title: Vintage Christmas Watercolor Clipart Set
author: Patishop Art
description:
Create charming holiday designs with this vintage Christmas watercolor clipart collection, filled with whimsical pastel Christmas illustrations and nostalgic winter details. The collection includes high-resolution Christmas PNG elements featuring Santa, angels, reindeer, snowmen, ornaments, bows, holly, berries, winter houses, frames and festive decorations, plus coordinating Christmas seamless patterns. Perfect for Christmas cards, invitations, stationery, scrapbooking, educational materials, printable projects and festive small-business designs. A playful whimsical holiday clipart collection with a sweet vintage storybook feel.
♡What is included:
56 high-resolution illustrations with transparent background | .png
4 seamless patterns sized 12” x 12” | 3600×3600 at 300 dpi | .jpeg
4 (x2) A4 premade backgrounds at 300 dpi | .jpeg
